authority: Synthetic diagnostic dimensions, not Conex product dimensions or an adopted house section.

fixedStoppedSockets.scope: Necessary first axial release only; not full withdrawal, seal reuse, support or hydraulic acceptance.

rightTerminalBodyRemoved.scope: Assumes the opposite terminal body has ALREADY been removed; neither its removal nor full carrier extraction is proved.

rightBayTooShort.scope: Assumes the opposite terminal body has ALREADY been removed; neither its removal nor full carrier extraction is proved.

bareTubeOnly.scope: Straight concentric envelope only; no ovality, sag, clocking, friction, joint separation or loaded withdrawal proof.

plateStillAttached.scope: Straight concentric envelope only; no ovality, sag, clocking, friction, joint separation or loaded withdrawal proof.

compressionRingUnmeasured.scope: Actual carried ring/plate/support envelope is required; a bare-tube diameter cannot substitute.

excluded: Fitting-body removal itself and exact product insertion depths
Olive release, tube damage and seal/component reuse
Lateral manoeuvres, body flexibility and full-length withdrawal corridor
Carrier and terminal supports, movement and loads
Court-to-sleeve annular water boundary and floor continuity
Hydraulic capacity, safe water level, pressure duty and site acceptance
